title: Use TypedDict for dict-returning helper functions
description:
session_dict(), window_dict(), and pane_dict() (lines 36-65) return plain dicts with fixed, predictable keys. Using TypedDict would:

- Enable static type checking on dict access
- Provide IDE autocomplete for consumers
- Document the structure in code

Example fix:

class SessionInfo(TypedDict):
    name: str
    id: str
    created: int
    attached: bool
    windows: int

def session_dict(s: libtmux.Session) -> SessionInfo:
    ...
